pains.title: Licenses keep rising
pains.body: Teradata, Netezza, Exadata, and SAP BW carry end-of-life clocks and support bills that only go up.

pains.title: Infrastructure to babysit
pains.body: Appliances to patch, clusters to tune, capacity bought a year ahead and idle half the time.

pains.title: Analytics that crawl
pains.body: Row-based engines and overloaded clusters turn every dashboard into an overnight batch.

gains.title: Cost that flexes with use
gains.body: Compute by the second, scaled independently from storage. No idle clusters.

gains.title: One governed foundation
gains.body: One source of truth with access, lineage, and policy built in through Horizon, so decisions run on numbers people trust.

gains.title: AI is the next step
gains.body: Cortex and the leading models run next to the governed data, so the first AI use cases ship from the same foundation, not another project.

tangle.ariaLabel: A tangle of legacy systems: warehouse, ETL tools, data marts, and file exports all cross-wired

foundation.ariaLabel: One governed Snowflake foundation: sources flow into governed layers and decisions flow out

cutover.parity: Row + aggregate + hash parity, reconciled nightly
